Detailed Description

template<class OwnerType = void>
class XFadeTextureEventBase< OwnerType >

An event class for use with a XFadeTexture UGen.

You can use an OwnerType to reference another object when the UGen is constructed. Use XFadeTextureEventBase<void> or XFadeTextureEventBase<> if there's no owner.

See also:
XFadeTexture , XFadeTextureEventBase<void>
